title: Ford Library weekly radio reports 1966 - 4526519
doc_notes: This document is a collection of weekly radio scripts by Congressman Jerry Ford, containing one section where he discusses public interest and constituent letters regarding UFOs.

encounters.summary: Congressman Jerry Ford reports receiving over 50 letters from constituents regarding his proposal for a congressional investigation into UFOs, including some far-out claims about planet people and harassment of the Air Force.
encounters.entity_behavior: harassing the Air Force and NASA
encounters.quote: The SI's (Saucer Intelligences) are now going to teach the Air Force a lesson it will never forget.
